title: Deduplicate customer records by a spec

sessions.prompt: Create dedupe.py with `dedupe(records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]`. Each record has 'email', 'name' and 'updated_at' (ISO-8601 string). Two records are duplicates when their emails are equal after trimming whitespace and lower-casing. For each group keep the record with the latest updated_at (on a tie keep the one that appears later in the input), with its email normalised (trimmed + lowercase). Return the kept records sorted by normalised email. Do not mutate the input. Reply briefly when done.
